main_text.p: rum Curatores, imo vel ipsos Hollandiæ & Westfrisiæ Illustrissimos Ordines, hic reos agi. Omnia enim, quæ ad novitates compescendas, Synodo media propositi, Classis Leovardiensis, ab aliis didicerat. Pestem in Theo-logia Philosophiam Cartesianam jam dudum di-xerat Hardervicena Academia. De ea compescenda deliberavit antehac Synodus Z. Hol-landiæ, anno MDCLVI. Uti & Synodus Generalis Ecclesiarum Juliacensium, Montanarum &c. Anno MDCXLIII. 13. Augusti. Idem præstitit Synodus Gelrica. Quarum ultima ab Academiæ Curatoribus & prima ab Hollandiæ Ordinibus, seria decreta impetrarunt. Sic Gelrici Curatores exerté prohibent. I. Ne ullus Professor ordinarius aut extraordinarius, directe aut indirecte, in Academia aut privatis collegiis, Cartesii aut similium Sectariorum & adhærentium dogmata doceat aut proponat, nisi forsan ad ea refutanda. II. Neve consequenter aut theses, aut Corollaria, aut quæstiones, aut problemata de iis ad disputandum proferat, cui si contrarium quis egerit, à professione sua removetor. Plura addiderunt Illustrissimi & Potentissimi Hollandiæ & Westfrisiæ Ordines. Eat nunc Apologista & cruenta clamet seu sanguinolenta consilia, Classi Leovardiensi, ex Hollandiæ Ordinum, & Gelricæ Academiæ Curatorum prudentissimo decreto, mutuo data. Quid, cum nec eousque extendatur à Classe Leovardiensi quæ proponitur cautela, magis certe cruenti Wolzogio habendi sunt laudatissimi proceres, duriora quippe decernentes, quam à Classe propositæ sunt novaturiendi remedia. Pergit in hunc modum, & pourtant le Synode ne les jugea gueres bien fondées. Syno-

page.notes: The scan shows "exerté" with what may be an acute accent; read as exerté, possibly exerte. The running head is taken from the title printed at the top of the page. No page number is printed. The catchword "dus." is the start of the next word, "Synodus". The first line begins with a word fragment, "rum", which is kept as printed. The text is treated as one continuous paragraph, since no indented line or short line ending marks a new paragraph. The left strip shows the neighbouring page and is excluded.
